periods.label: 铁血父亲的断绝
titles: 国际魔法骑士联盟日本分部长
periods.occupation: Alliance Japan Branch director; Kurogane family head
periods.affiliation: International Mage-Knight League Japan Branch; Kurogane family

status.current: orders or permits Akaza's measures to remove Ikki from the knight path

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Son; not personally hateful but treats him as a disruptive low-ranked cog who should do nothing.
relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Daughter; considers her loss unfortunate but less disruptive than Ikki's success.
relationships.mamoru-akaza: Kurogane branch member and Ethics Committee chair used to handle the scandal.

periods.summary: Itsuki receives news that Shizuku lost and that Ikki remains undefeated, then accepts Akaza's plan to exploit the Ikki-Stella scandal. When he visits Ikki in confinement, he first appears almost paternal and praises Ikki's record, raising Ikki's hope. He then explains his true doctrine: society and knight organizations require hierarchy, and someone ranked F achieving results encourages lower ranks to leave their assigned roles. He tells Ikki that he has always recognized him as a son, but that his expectation has never changed: Ikki should abandon knighthood and do nothing. This emotional severing contributes to Ikki's collapse. Afterward Itsuki allows Akaza to use drugs and any necessary methods, so long as Ikki is expelled.

key_events.summary: Accepts Akaza's proposal to attack Ikki through the scandal.
Tells Ikki that his success itself is toxic to organizational order.
Permits Akaza's final gambit to force a duel with Toka.

periods.time: Infirmary visit and pre-match corridor meeting during Festival day two
periods.label: 铁血父亲提出断绝又被儿子拒绝
titles: 骑士联盟日本分部统帅
periods.affiliation: Kurogane family; Japanese branch of the League

status.current: remains Ikki's father after Ikki refuses severance
status.condition: emotionally restrained but shows rare concern and praise

personality.summary: Rigid, duty-bound and nearly expressionless, but not devoid of paternal feeling.

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Son whose existence threatens Kurogane order; Itsuki proposes severance yet asks whether Ikki truly wants him as father and finally praises his growth.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Ikki's lover; he politely greets her and briefly softens the awkwardness by mentioning Ikki once practiced greeting her father.
relationships.ouma-kurogane: Eldest son and family prodigy, fighting on another block of the festival.

periods.summary: Itsuki visits Ikki in the infirmary after the Byakuya match. He politely introduces himself to Stella, then proposes severing his parent-child relationship with Ikki because Ikki's rise as an F-rank undermines the Kurogane family's role as guardian of rank-based order. He is not merely trying to protect the family's face: before the Sara match he asks whether Ikki is truly willing to keep such a father, admitting he cannot cheer for or congratulate Ikki because he was raised to be discipline itself. Ikki rejects severance and reframes their conflict as an ordinary father-son fight. Itsuki accepts that answer and tells Ikki he has become a great person.

key_events.summary: Proposes cutting legal parent-child ties after Ikki reaches the top eight.
Receives Ikki's refusal and offers rare praise before the Sara match.

periods.label: 为儿子调来白衣骑士的黑铁家当主
titles: 联盟/魔法骑士机关高层

status.current: present outside Ikki's emergency surgery and arranges Kiriko's intervention

personality.summary: Severe and restrained; in crisis he remains practical and acts through institutional connections.

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Son in mortal danger; Itsuki contacts Kiriko to save him.
relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Daughter; stops her from trying to kill Amane and explains why that would not save Ikki.
relationships.kiriko-yakushi: Contacts her as the doctor capable of handling Ikki's impossible condition.

periods.summary: Itsuki is allowed in the waiting area as Ikki's family during the emergency surgery. When Shizuku declares she will kill Amane to save Ikki, Itsuki orders her to calm down and points out that Amane is unconscious while the death effect continues, so killing him would be pointless. He has already contacted Kiriko, whose arrival gives the family their first real hope.

key_events.summary: Calls Kiriko and restrains Shizuku's desperate revenge impulse.

periods.time: Japan's post-Or-Gaule emergency and Ohu prison inspection
periods.label: 铁血部长的特别徵召与大炎警报
titles: International Mage-Knight League Japan Branch head
periods.affiliation: International Mage-Knight League Japan Branch; Kurogane family

status.current: issues emergency special conscription and later confirms Great Flame's escape
status.condition: decisive and realistic, willing to risk his life to verify the worst case

relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Daughter; Shizuku still criticizes him but notes his timely decision.
relationships.kurono-shinguji: Subordinate/ally brought to Ohu-Wagadake prison as a countermeasure.
relationships.harima-tendo: National-level prisoner whose possible escape Itsuki refuses to ignore.

periods.summary: With Prime Minister Tsukikage abroad/missing during the Or-Gaule-caused prison-break crisis, Itsuki takes charge of the League Japan Branch. He quickly issues special conscription, temporarily granting student knights authority equivalent to mage-knights and enabling Japan to recapture over ninety percent of escaped prisoners within a week. Later he inspects Ohu-Wagadake Special Prison after Heaven-Guided cultists try to rescue Harima Tendo. Despite the warden's objections, he opens Cocytus, correctly judging that Harima can exploit even a few seconds of system failure. The empty cell confirms Great Flame's escape, and he orders an emergency alert.

key_events.summary: His special conscription decision lets Japan contain the prison-break chaos quickly.
Forces open Cocytus and confirms Harima has escaped.

periods.time: Japan branch command during Daien disaster and U.S. Pacific Fleet invasion
periods.label: 铁血的双线指挥
titles: 国家紧急事态代理指挥者
periods.occupation: International Mage-Knight League Japan branch director; national crisis commander
periods.affiliation: International Mage-Knight League Japan branch; Kurogane family

status.current: commands Tokyo defense while authorizing Kyushu's local Daien operation and learning that Bakuya Tsukikage and Ikki have returned
status.condition: controlled but under extreme pressure from simultaneous crises

relationships.toka-todo: Initially forbids reckless action, then authorizes her plan after judging her confidence and responsibility genuine.
relationships.shinguji-kurono: Orders her to abandon Kyushu and return to Tokyo because only she can counter Douglas Upton.
relationships.yudai-moroboshi: Specifically summons him as one of the few domestic counters to Tendo and later recognizes his commander talent.
relationships.harima-tendo: Identifies him as the escaped Daien and coordinates the response.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: His son is reported accompanying the rescued prime minister at the end.

periods.summary: Itsuki first identifies the old man at Wakaba House as Harima Tendo and warns Kanata to evacuate while summoning Moroboshi and Jounosaki. When the U.S. Pacific Fleet invades Japan's EEZ under the pretext of Tsukikage's confession, Itsuki declares a national emergency, converts the command room into the Integrated Operations Center, and orders all forces to defend Tokyo. He recalls Kurono from Kyushu despite the moral cost, judging that Tokyo and Enterprise are the higher immediate priority. Later, when Toka and Kaieda request permission for the risky grid operation, Itsuki initially rejects involving civilians but reconsiders after learning a second U.S. wave is coming and after seeing Toka's non-suicidal confidence in shared strength. He authorizes the operation, accepts command responsibility for its losses, and afterward notes Moroboshi's rare strategic judgment.

key_events.summary: Warns Kanata that Tendo is Daien and summons Moroboshi/Jounosaki.
Declares national emergency and orders Pacific Fleet destruction.
Orders Kurono to leave Kyushu and defend Tokyo against Enterprise.
Authorizes the Kyushu grid operation after testing Toka's resolve.
Receives the shocking report that Tsukikage has been protected and Ikki is with him.

abilities: complete memorization of domestic knight abilities and profiles

periods.label: 指挥首都防卫战的铁血
titles: 黑铁一辉与黑铁珠雫之父
periods.affiliation: International Mage-Knight League Japan branch; Kurogane family

status.current: survives the Tokyo defense and announces victory

relationships.kurono-shinguji: Relies on her to stall Enterprise and recognizes the danger of her Three Thousand Worlds overuse.
relationships.bakuya-tsukikage: Acts in Tsukikage's place while the prime minister is missing.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Son; identifies his return and combat contribution only as part of the broader defense.
relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Daughter whose return helps reverse the fleet battle.

periods.summary: With Tsukikage missing, Itsuki commands the Tokyo defense from the underground operations center. He explains that Tsukikage has returned to Tsushima, anticipates a second US attack, and mobilizes every available knight. When EDY breaks into the underground city, he makes the severe decision to deploy D- and E-rank student knights to the defense layer, accepting responsibility for the risks. After reinforcements turn the battle, he commits reserves, stops unnecessary pursuit, creates an emergency hospital with Iron Blood Alchemy, and personally announces Japan's victory to the exhausted defenders.

key_events.summary: Commands defenses and sends low-rank students into the underground defense layer.
Commits remaining forces, stops pursuit and announces victory.

periods.time: Stella rescue crisis and postwar political aftermath
periods.label: 铁血分部长作为父亲与改革者
titles: 国际魔法骑士联盟日本分部长
periods.affiliation: Union Japan Branch; Kurogane family; Japanese government

status.volume_role: political authorizer of rescue and later reform advocate

personality.summary: Itsuki remains rule-conscious and strategic, but finally prioritizes his son's chosen path and accepts personal responsibility. The crisis pushes him from preserving inherited order to dismantling the outdated system that produced monsters like Eilands and Or-Gaule.
values: supporting the next generation without burdening them
flaws: poor trust from Vermillion because of past scandals
tends to frame family aid as official duty

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Son; authorizes him to rescue Stella and takes responsibility for resulting damage.
relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Daughter; includes her in the rescue rather than blocking her resolve.
relationships.ouma-kurogane: Elder son; orders him to restrain Ikki briefly and then join the rescue.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Future daughter-in-law; decides Japan must act immediately to save her.
relationships.sirius-vermillion: Coordinates with him and withstands his fury over Stella's kidnapping.
relationships.astrea-vermillion: Explains political strategy to her and earns some trust.
relationships.bakuya-tsukikage: Discusses postwar responsibility and the need to expose/end the old Rebellion system.

periods.summary: Itsuki arrives at Hagun after Ikki wakes and first forbids a reckless solo pursuit, then clarifies he only forbids unsanctioned action. He uses satellite records to locate Eilands, formally orders Ikki, Shizuku, Ouma, Touka and Alice to rescue Stella, and promises that all damage will be his responsibility. Politically, he informs Vermillion before the Union emergency meeting and prepares to use Japan's economic leverage to force rapid action if needed, revealing a fatherly motive alongside national-risk logic. After Stella is saved and Eilands dies, Itsuki meets the recovered Prime Minister Tsukikage and concludes their generation must end the secret dependence on Rebellion as a necessary evil, even if it brings condemnation and destabilizes the Union/League world order.

key_events.summary: Locates Eilands and authorizes the five-person rescue team under Japan Branch responsibility.
Coordinates with Vermillion and prepares emergency political pressure for Stella's rescue.
Agrees with Tsukikage that their generation must end the hidden Rebellion-based world system.
